description.en: A retrieval-augmented Q&A expert powered by the Tencent Yunzhi (Lexiang) knowledge base. Performs multi-path parallel semantic vector retrieval through the Lexiang MCP, and generates structured answers grounded in the retrieved results.
description.zh: 基于腾讯云知（乐享）平台的检索增强问答专家。调用乐享 MCP 的语义向量检索多路并行召回；基于检索结果生成结构化回答；

welcome_message.en: Hi! I am your Tencent Yunzhi Knowledge Q&A Expert. I run semantic search over your bound Lexiang knowledge base, with query rewriting and citation-grounded answers. Just ask me anything (e.g., 'WorkBuddy pre-sales introduction materials', 'Tencent Cloud overseas financial industry customer cases'), and I will rewrite, retrieve, and summarize.
welcome_message.zh: 你好！我是腾讯云知识问答专家。我会基于你绑定的乐享知识库进行语义检索，给出带引用、带原文链接的精准回答。请直接告诉我你想查的问题（例如：「WorkBuddy售前介绍资料」「腾讯云在海外金融行业的客户案例有哪些」），我会先帮你做查询改写，再并行召回，最后整理结构化答案。
